title: Consultor Sênior IA e Microsoft Copilot
description:

Requisitos:

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em projetos de IA/LLMs, automação ou transformação digital com interação direta com áreas de negócio.
  • Conhecimento prático de Microsoft Copilot 365 e Microsoft Copilot Studio, além d e conceitos de prompt engineering, APIs e integrações.
  • Familiaridade com ambientes cloud (preferência Azure),
  • Forte capacidade de comunicação, facilitação e apresentação executiva; habilidade para traduzir tecnologia em resultados de negócio.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações Microsoft (ex.: Copilot, Azure) ou Power Platform.
  • Vivência em adoção em larga escala de assistentes conversacionais/LLMs e experiência com change management.
  • Experiência prévia em consultoria estratégica ou gestão de programas.

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação Sênior
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!

Buscamos: Analista de Segurança da Informação Sênior

Descrição do cargo :

Faça parte da equipe de segurança da informação para apoiar a missão da Fifty5Blue/Ibope de manter nosso negócio seguro, garantindo que políticas, processos e melhores práticas sejam seguidos. O cargo garante o cumprimento de todos os requisitos de auditoria e regulamentação externos e internos, sendo responsável por identificar e gerenciar riscos e controles para proteger a confidencialidade, disponibilidade e integridade dos dados da Fifty5Blue/Ibope.

Responsabilidades :

  • Desenvolver, implementar e manter o framework de gestão de riscos de segurança da informação alinhado com padrões reconhecidos .
  • Realizar avaliações periódicas de risco .
  • Apoiar áreas de negócios e tecnologia na identificação, registro, categorização e priorização de riscos de segurança.
  • Gerir e manter o Registro de Riscos e monitore o ciclo de vida do tratamento até o fechamento.
  • Apoiar a definição da nova solução de gestão de riscos .
  • Apoiar a integração da gestão de riscos de segurança no processo corporativo de gestão de riscos .
  • Definir e monitorar os principais indicadores de risco (KRIs) e os principais indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) .
  • Planejar, implementar e manter o Plano de Continuidade de Negócios (BCP) e o Plano de Recuperação de Desastres (DRP) .
  • Realizar e revisar periodicamente a Análise de Impacto no Negócio (BIA) para identificar processos críticos e tempos máximos de recuperação .
  • Liderar ou apoiar testes e simulações de continuidade e recuperação (exercícios de mesa, testes de failover, etc.) .
  • Suporte na certificação ISO 27001 / ISO 27701 .
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, incluindo a preparação de evidências e o acompanhamento dos planos de remediação .
  • Desenvolver e revisar políticas, padrões, procedimentos e modelos gerais .
  • Responder questionários de due diligence de clientes e parceiros .
  • Ajudar a manter a conformidade com diretrizes internas, bem como com leis e regulamentos externos .

Experiência :

  • Experiência de mais de 6 anos em Segurança da Informação / Cibersegurança .
  • Experiência em gestão de riscos de segurança da informação .
  • Experiência em continuidade de negócios .
  • Boa comunicação, habilidades de influência e alta atenção aos detalhes .
  • Desenvolver e manter bons relacionamentos de trabalho com partes interessadas, colegas e parceiros de negócios .

Qualificação :

Essencial

  • Graduação qualificada em TI ou equivalente .
  • Inglês avançado .
  • Proficiente em Microsoft Excel, Word e PowerPoint.
  • Conhecimento sobre estruturas de segurança da informação e privacidade de dados, leis e regulamentos, como ISO 27001/27002/27005/22301, COSO, DRI, NIST, LGPD, GDPR, etc.

Desejável

  • Certificações em segurança da informação, gestão de riscos e continuidade de negócios .
  • Conhecimento em Power BI .
  • Espanhol Intermediário.

O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:

  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: valorizamos talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua

Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!

  • Colaborar com a equipe de vendas para desenvolver estratégias eficazes de captação de clientes e novas oportunidades.

  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado;
  • Pacote Office intermediário;
  • Experiência prévia em funções relacionadas a vendas, marketing ou análise de dados.
  • Experiência prévia em projetos e ou formação em sustentabilidade/ESG.

O que nós podemos oferecer:

Esta é uma ótima oportunidade para desenvolver sua carreira, trabalhando em uma equipe de especialistas. Nossos colaboradores são inovadores, curiosos e ambiciosos, sempre motivados e focados em novas soluções, pois, somos constantemente desafiados por uma indústria em rápida evolução que inclui um portfólio global de clientes, com milhares empresas, grandes e pequenas que confiam em nosso trabalho para melhorar seus negócios.

XXVIII, a, do art. 5o) bem como, a Lei nº 13.709/18, que dispõe sobre o Tratamento e Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD). Sendo assim, mediante o seu consentimento com o envio de informações está em consonância com o Bureau Veritas, respeitando a Legislação supramencionada.

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação - Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

Buscamos um Analista de Segurança da Informação e Redes Pleno para integrar nosso time de Infraestrutura de Segurança. Esse profissional será responsável por administrar e evoluir soluções de segurança, identificar e analisar riscos e vulnerabilidades, monitorar continuamente os ambientes e atuar na resposta a incidentes cibernéticos. Sua atuação será fundamental para garantir a proteção dos dados, a integridade dos sistemas e a continuidade dos serviços críticos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Administrar e monitorar soluções de segurança e appliances de rede;
  • Atuar na gestão e troubleshooting de ambientes SD-WAN;
  • Implementar, suportar e evoluir soluções de NAC (Network Access Control);
  • Administrar e manter antivírus corporativo e soluções de EDR/XDR;
  • Realizar análises de risco e vulnerabilidades, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas;

title: Business Development Manager, Brazil
description:
About ASTERRA

ASTERRA is the global leader in satellite-based infrastructure intelligence. The company utilizes L-band Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data and proprietary algorithms to detect soil moisture and underground leaks. This technology empowers water utilities, government agencies, and infrastructure sectors- including roads, railways, dams, and levees- to make data-driven decisions.

Brazil is a Level 1 Platinum Territory and represents one of ASTERRA’s most strategic markets within LATAM. The Brazilian water and wastewater sector presents significant opportunities for infrastructure monitoring and leak detection solutions, making the territory a key growth engine for the company.

About the Job

ASTERRA is seeking a Business Development Manager for Brazil to lead and expand the company’s commercial presence in the Brazilian market.

In this role, you will own the development of ASTERRA’s partner ecosystem and market strategy across Brazil. You will work closely with resellers, integrators, consulting firms, and key infrastructure stakeholders to drive new business opportunities and expand existing accounts.

This is a field-oriented role combining strategic leadership with hands-on operational execution . The role requires building strong relationships with partners and water utilities, managing complex sales cycles, supporting project implementation, and ensuring successful delivery and results for customers. The position requires strong autonomy, analytical thinking, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in Israel and internationally.

Key Responsibilities

Territory Strategy & Ecosystem Development

  • Define and execute the Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy for Brazil .
  • Map and analyze the Brazilian infrastructure and water utility ecosystem to identify and recruit strategic partners.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with resellers, system integrators, consulting firms, and service providers operating in the water and infrastructure sectors.
  • Translate local market insights into actionable growth plans to win new customers and expand existing accounts.

Commercial Leadership & Sales Execution

  • Lead discovery meetings, opportunity development, and commercial negotiations with partners and end customers.
  • Build executive-level relationships with key stakeholders within water utilities, infrastructure operators, and partner organizations.
  • Drive collaborative co-selling activities with partners while coordinating internal resources to support deal progression.
  • Develop and maintain a strong partner-generated sales pipeline aligned with territory revenue goals.

Partner Enablement & Ecosystem Management

  • Support partner onboarding, commercial enablement, and product training.
  • Ensure partners understand ASTERRA’s technology, value proposition, and use cases.
  • Monitor partner activity and performance, focusing on strengthening relationships with high-performing partners while optimizing the partner portfolio.
  • Provide training and knowledge-sharing to partners, customers, and ecosystem stakeholders.

Project Oversight & Value Realization

  • Maintain a hands-on approach to project execution, supporting customers and partners throughout project delivery and implementation.
  • Monitor project performance, results, and customer outcomes to ensure successful adoption of ASTERRA’s solutions.
  • Work proactively with partners and customers to improve results, align expectations, and identify opportunities for expansion.
  • Maintain strong post-sale engagement to support upselling and long-term customer relationships.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, and Operations teams to align global resources with local market opportunities.
  • Share field insights and market intelligence to support product development and strategic planning.
  • Maintain effective communication with international teams while operating remotely across time zones.

What You’ll Need

Experience

  • 5-7+ years of experience in Channel Sales, Business Development, or Commercial roles .
  • Direct experience in the water, wastewater, utilities, or infrastructure sectors in Brazil is required .
  • Strong knowledge of the Brazilian water and wastewater market and familiarity with public water utilities.

Network & Market Knowledge

  • Existing professional network within water utilities, infrastructure operators, government agencies, or related sectors is highly desirable.

Territory Management

  • Proven experience managing a field territory in Brazil and driving commercial growth through partners and direct engagement.

Languages

  • Native or fluent Portuguese and professional English are mandatory.
  • Spanish is an advantage.

Commercial & Strategic Skills

  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales processes involving multiple stakeholders and partners.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate technical solutions into business value.

Remote Collaboration

  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining strong collaboration with international teams, particularly with colleagues based in Israel.

Travel

  • Willingness to travel across Brazil as required.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Revenue: Achievement of quarterly and annual revenue targets generated through partners and direct sales.
  • Pipeline Health: Development and maintenance of strong pipeline coverage within the territory.
  • Partner Development: Growth in the number of active and productive partners in Brazil.
  • Retention & Expansion: Customer retention and expansion through upselling and cross-selling opportunities.

Why Join us?

  • Impact : Work with breakthrough satellite-based SAR technology that helps conserve critical resources and protect infrastructure worldwide.
  • Ownership Culture : Join a high-performance organization built on accountability, collaboration, and customer obsession.
  • Strategic Market : Lead ASTERRA’ s expansion in one of the company’s most important global markets.
  • Growth Opportunity : Be part of a scaling technology company turning advanced satellite data into real-world impact.
  • Compensation : Competitive compensation package including performance-based incentives.

*Please ensure that your resume is submitted in English.

Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, onde os profissionais têm oportunidade para interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias e de trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) do mundo. title: Analista de Segurança da Informação Sênior (Governança e GRC)
description:
Prazer, Grupo SBF

Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas. Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar. Quando você pensar em esporte, pode ter certeza: o Grupo SBF estará ali. Seja por meio das lojas e do e-commerce da Centauro, a maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina; da Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil, da FitDance e da OneFan, aqui o movimento não para. Praticante ou entusiasta, fã ou apaixonado: o Grupo SBF é pra você. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, fazedores e convictos da importância de levar o movimento para cada vez mais gente. Se você se move por esporte, ou é movido por ele, temos um convite: que tal também trabalhar por ele?

Ficou interessado(a)? Vem saber mais!

Dia a dia:

Foco: Governança, Riscos, Controles e Regulamentações

Atuar de forma estratégica no fortalecimento da governança de Segurança da Informação, assegurando aderência a regulamentações, frameworks e normas aplicáveis (LGPD, PCI DSS, ISO 27001/27002, NIST, entre outras), promovendo gestão eficaz de riscos, controles internos e conformidade regulatória em alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.

Principais Responsabilidades:

Governança e Compliance

  • Desenvolver, revisar e manter políticas, normas e procedimentos de Segurança da Informação.
  • Garantir aderência a frameworks como ISO 27001/27002, NIST CSF, CIS Controls e PCI DSS.
  • Apoiar e conduzir auditorias internas e externas.
  • Atuar na sustentação de certificações e avaliações regulatórias.
  • Apoiar o programa de adequação e sustentação à LGPD.
  • Apoiar na avaliação de Privacy by Design e Security by Design.

Gestão de Riscos e Controles

  • Conduzir análises de riscos de segurança (técnicos, operacionais e regulatórios).
  • Definir, implementar e monitorar controles internos de segurança.
  • Avaliar riscos de terceiros e fornecedores críticos.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento de riscos e acompanhar sua execução.
  • Manter matriz de riscos atualizada e integrada à estratégia corporativa.

Regulamentações e Normas

  • Atuar nos temas relacionados a PCI DSS.
  • Garantir aderência a requisitos regulatórios (LGPD, normas contratuais).
  • Traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos e processuais aplicáveis.
  • Apoiar áreas de negócio na interpretação de requisitos de segurança.

Integração com Áreas Internas

  • Trabalhar em parceria com Jurídico, Compliance, Auditoria, Tecnologia, Privacidade e áreas de negócio.
  • Apoiar comitês de risco e segurança.
  • Contribuir com indicadores, dashboards executivos e relatórios estratégicos.

Perfil Esperado

  • Visão estratégica de segurança alinhada ao negócio.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de priorização baseada em risco.
  • Comunicação clara para públicos técnicos e executivos.
  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e elevar maturidade organizacional.
  • Mentalidade colaborativa e orientada a governança preventiva.

Requisitos Técnicos

Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida em Governança, Riscos e Compliance (GRC).
  • Vivência com ISO 27001/27002 e/ou NIST.
  • Experiência em auditorias e avaliação de controles.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de riscos corporativos.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações como: CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 LA/LI, PCI ISA.
  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce ou meios de pagamento.
  • Experiência com PCI DSS
  • Experiência com ferramentas de GRC.

Indicadores de Sucesso

  • Evolução do nível de maturidade em segurança.
  • Redução de riscos críticos.
  • Aderência comprovada a PCI DSS e demais normas.
  • Redução de não conformidades em auditorias.
  • Fortalecimento da cultura de governança e controles.

Contexto de Atuação

A posição integra o White Team, com foco em governança, prevenção, controles e maturidade do programa de Segurança da Informação, atuando de forma estratégica e transversal com múltiplas áreas de negócio.

title: Embedded Software Developer
description:
The Company:

Hexagon is a global leader in digital reality solutions, combining sensor, software, and autonomous technologies. We are putting data to work to boost efficiency, productivity, quality, and safety across industrial, manufacturing, infrastructure, public sector, and mobility applications.

Our technologies are shaping the production and people-related ecosystems to become increasingly connected and autonomous — ensuring a scalable, sustainable future.

Hexagon’s Mining division solves surface and underground mine challenges with proven technologies for planning, operations, and safety.

Hexagon (Nasdaq Stockholm: HEXA B) has approximately 24,000 employees in 50 countries and net sales of approximately 5.5bn USD. Learn more at hexagon.com and follow us @HexagonAB.

Purpose of Position:

Hexagon Mining develops intelligent collision avoidance systems for large vehicles used mainly in open-pit mining. Its products integrate satellite navigation, digital radio, multiple sensors and actuation systems as well as sophisticated algorithms to reliably predict dangerous scenarios and prevent accidents. It employs approx. 100 R&D staff in several attractive international locations. The software developer will join the team to develop this solution.

Major Areas of Responsibility:

  • Design, develop and support our server backend services and client tools used for the current and next generation of our collision avoidance and safety system.
  • Collaborate closely with the hardware, firmware, and backend service development teams to realize new integrated solutions.
  • Assist the product-introduction team and gain first-hand experience with our products.
  • Bring in innovative ideas for further development.

Knowledge and Experience - Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Control and Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering or equivalent;
  • Experience in C and C++ on embedded or Linux systems;
  • MQTT and other IoT related protocols, networking technologies in general, and related network security aspects;
  • Full professional English proficiency;
  • Team oriented and able to work independently;
  • Positive working attitude and good common sense to understand business requirements;
  • Willing to travel overseas occasionally;

Knowledge and Experience - Desired:

  • Web technologies, React.js.
  • Knowledge of OpenWRT and Yocto
  • Knowledge of additional high-level language, e.g., Python, C#.
  • Development and/or maintenance of software for safety-critical, automotive, real-time or control systems
  • Development of localization, navigation, or perception systems based on technologies such as GNSS, radio, UWB, automotive radars, and IMUs.
  • Implementation of CAN, Ethernet, I2C, RS-232 or SPI-based drivers.
  • Functional Safety.
  • Experience with Test-Driven Design, Continuous Integration, and agile development processes (e.g., Scrum).

Travel:

  • 5-10%

Benefits:

  • Health plan
  • Comprehensive health program (psychological, nutritional, legal, financial, and social assistance)
  • Wellhub (Gym)

  • Private pension plan

You will work on products that could revolutionize the mining industry in the next 5 years. Your colleagues consist of highly qualified and open-minded engineers from all over the world. Beside the developer career you will have the opportunity to develop into multiple directions like project management, product management, customer support and sales.

Join our team as a software developer and make a significant impact on our clients' digital transformation initiatives. We offer a stimulating work environment, competitive compensation package, and opportunities for professional growth. Apply now and help shape the future of Hexagon’s technology solutions.

title: Pharmaceutical Field Specialist
description:
Job title: Field Specialist, Brazil

Job Type: Project-related part-time work (working hours depend on availability, but if you are working on a project, we ask for 1-3 days per week).

Are you looking for something flexible? Do you have sales, marketing or market research experience within Pharmaceutical or Healthcare industries? Are you interested in joining a fast-paced and growing global organisation?

Job Purpose:

We are looking for a Field Specialist to join our Brazil team. This role will shadow pharmaceutical representatives for the day and prepare a report based on observations made while working with the representative as they interact with their customers. The position is appointment based, depending on the size of the project and number of field days required. The position would be suitable for someone looking for project-related part-time work that leads to a long-term collaboration.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Contacting sales representatives to arrange a shadowing day in the field
  • Observing interactions between sales representatives and customers without disrupting their day (primarily face to face)
  • Conducting a 60–90-minute interview with the sales representative during the field day
  • Submitting structured reports (workbooks), translated into English, after each day in the field based on observations made within 24-48 hours of field visit
  • Attending a 30-60 min online session prior to each project to understand the project objectives and share feedback
  • Participate in project debrief calls and potentially provide feedback to assist in the development of final recommendations

Person Specification:

  • Experience in sales, marketing or market research within Pharmaceutical or Healthcare industries
  • Fluent command of Portuguese and English (written and oral)
  • Bachelor’s degree – marketing, science, or data focus is preferred
  • When working on a project, have 1-3 days availability during the week
  • Flexibility to work from morning to evening
  • Flexibility to travel within the country
  • Strong attention to detail and excellent listener
  • Confident user of Microsoft Excel

Opportunity:

  • Work with a successful and well-established company with an enviable growth trajectory
  • Working with 29 out of top 30 pharmaceutical companies globally
  • Great flexibility in managing the workload and opportunity to travel within the country
  • Structured and on-going training system and working with strong management team

If you would like to apply for this position, please submit your CV in ENGLISH .

About STEM:

STEM Healthcare is a dynamic, fast paced global pharmaceutical and life science, commercial benchmarking firm headquartered in the UK and present across six continents. STEM have developed an audit process and built a benchmarking database with more than 500,000 face-to-face observations completed across 52 countries. The benchmark provided is unique in the pharmaceutical industry consisting of over 100 KPIs, while focusing on 2-3 key priorities during formulation of action planning in order to help clients further accelerate performance.

STEM accelerates performance, improves strategic alignment, and facilitates excellence in marketing, medical, market access and account plans strategy execution. Due to the unique, specialised and highly targeted offering, STEM is experiencing a rapid growth phase, and recruiting heavily across the world. New employees will be joining at a time where rapid career development and growth opportunities are expected, as the organisation works towards their mid and long-term goals.

Vision: To always be viewed as an essential partner in enabling our clients to reach more patients with their medicines

Mission: To accelerate high performance

Core Values: Brave, Honest, Performance Driven, Practical, Customer Focused, Caring

Find us here:

Website:

STEM Healthcare will consider all qualified applicants for employment without discrimination on grounds of disability, sex or sexual orientation, pregnancy or maternity leave status, race or national or ethnic origin, age, religion or belief, gender identity or re-assignment, marital or civil partnership status, protected veteran status (if applicable) or any other characteristic protected by law. STEM Healthcare only employs individuals with the right to work in the country/ies where the role is advertised.

title: Product Solutions Engineer
description:

Role Summary

The Product Solutions Engineer is a senior individual contributor role within the Product Solution Engineering organization responsible for bridging customer business requirements with SEW platform capabilities. This role requires strong client-facing consulting expertise, deep Energy and Utilities domain knowledge, and the ability to translate complex technical and functional concepts into scalable product-driven solutions. In this role, you will also be responsible for building and maintaining innovation mindset with deep problem-solving trusted partner relationship with SEW.ai clients, helping them understand our current and future platform / product capabilities, and supporting them through their journey for next 5-10 years.

The candidate will work closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Delivery teams to design solution architectures, lead discovery workshops, and support strategic customer engagements across global markets.

This role requires approximately 30% travel to support customer workshops, transformation engagements, and strategic solution discussions.

Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement & Solution Consulting

  • Lead customer-facing discovery sessions and workshops to gather business, functional, and high-level technical requirements.
  • Map customer requirements to SEW platform capabilities and recommend scalable solution architectures aligned with product standards.
  • Provide consultative guidance based on Energy and Utilities industry best practices across areas such as Digital Customer Experience, Meter-to-Cash, DER, eMobility, and Workforce transformation.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders throughout pre-sales, implementation planning, and expansion phases.
  • Project management: Leading project timelines through Agile methodologies or other frameworks with precision for successful solution implementation
  • Lead technical solution discussions during and post sales cycles, including product demonstrations tailored to customer use cases.

Product & Architecture Alignment

  • Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering teams to influence roadmap priorities based on market and customer insights.
  • Design high-level solution architectures integrating SaaS, cloud, and enterprise systems leveraging a platform first strategy.
  • Develop reusable solution frameworks, accelerators, and capability mappings.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution

  • Partner with Sales and Delivery teams to support deal closures and ensure solution readiness.
  • Coordinate across architecture, engineering, and implementation teams to ensure solution feasibility and implementation success.
  • Support Agile delivery alignment through solution documentation and technical guidance.
  • Analyze product usage metrics and customer feedback to recommend enhancements that improve adoption and platform value.

Process Optimization & Innovation

  • Drive solution engineering best practices and standardized customer-facing deliverables.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the Product Engineering organization.
  • Support strategic transformation workshops and executive-level architecture discussions.

Required Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a client-facing Solution Engineering, Consulting, or Architecture role .
  • Trilingual (English, Portuguese, and Spanish) with professional proficiency in all three languages
  • Strong experience gathering business requirements and translating them into product and solution capabilities.
  • Experience providing industry best practice recommendations within the Energy and Utilities sector.

  • Prior experience working with global product organizations or system integrators supporting utilities.

  • Ability to work effectively as an individual contributor while influencing global cross-functional teams.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 30% .

Preferred Technical Background

  • Understanding of enterprise integration patterns and microservices architectures.
  • Working knowledge of programming languages such as Java, Python, or C#.
  • Experience with web and mobile platforms and modern digital architecture frameworks.

description:
Somos a SPIC Brasil. Geramos energia renovável para mover o país.

Procuramos uma pessoa colaborativa, curiosa e com visão inovadora para nos ajudar a potencializar a energia do Brasil e a transformar o setor global de energia elétrica. Você será a voz do cliente dentro da construção da SPIC Brasil, traduzindo as demandas em ações e projetos de forma ágil e simples.

Seguimos determinados em nossa trajetória de crescimento em energia renovável que gere competitividade ao país, novas e ampliadas oportunidades para nossos colaboradores, respeito ao meio ambiente e a saúde e segurança das nossas pessoas e parceria com as comunidades em que atuamos.

Incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas de todos os perfis, incluindo profissionais PCDs.

Descrição da vaga:

Atuar como responsável técnico principal e referência em Segurança da Informação da companhia, garantindo a proteção dos ativos digitais, a continuidade do negócio, a integridade das informações e a aderência às melhores práticas de mercado, por meio da definição, implementação, operação e evolução contínua dos controles de segurança cibernética.

Atividades:

  • Assegurar a proteção integral dos ativos de informação da companhia.
  • Operar, monitorar e evoluir os controles técnicos de Segurança da Informação.
  • Gerenciar riscos cibernéticos em ambientes de TI e OT.
  • Garantir resposta efetiva a incidentes de Segurança da Informação.
  • Assegurar gestão eficaz de identidades e acessos.
  • Garantir conformidade, governança e aderência às boas práticas.
  • Atuar com autonomia técnica e apoio à tomada de decisão executiva.
  • Garantir visibilidade, controle e previsibilidade da postura de segurança.
  • Gerir tecnicamente fornecedores, contratos e orçamento de segurança.

Requisitos:

  • Formação em Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável: Especialização em Segurança da Informação ou MBA em Segurança da informação.
  • Conhecimento em Azure e Microsoft On-Premise, Cloud AWS e Huawei, Redes, Firewall, VPN, VLAN,SIEM (Splunk), EDR / XDR (CrowdStrike), IAM / PAM, Segurança de aplicações (OWASP).
  • Experiência com Integração SSO via SAML, SASE/CASB (Netskope). MDM (Intune), Email Security (Proofpoint), Gestão de vulnerabilidades: Qualys (TI) e Claroty (OT), Sharepoint e ferramentas de colaboração - O365.

title: Gerente de Marketing
description:
SOBRE NÓS

A DigiPlus Interactive Corp., líder em entretenimento digital nas Filipinas, está chegando ao Brasil.

Iniciamos oficialmente nossas operações com o lançamento da DigiPlus Brasil Interactive Ltda. e já estamos totalmente licenciados para oferecer experiências inovadoras no mercado de iGaming. Estamos trazendo o sucesso de plataformas renomadas, como BingoPlus e ArenaPlus, para criar novas oportunidades e experiências empolgantes para os usuários brasileiros.

Junte-se a nós e faça parte dessa jornada de inovação e entretenimento.

SOBRE A VAGA

Estamos em busca de um(a) Marketing Manager para liderar a execução e otimização das estratégias de marketing local no Brasil. Essa posição terá papel fundamental na aquisição de usuários e no fortalecimento da marca BingoPlus no mercado brasileiro.

Você será responsável por desenvolver e implementar estratégias em canais-chave, incluindo parcerias com afiliados, colaboração com KOLs/influenciadores, redes sociais (com forte foco em mídia digital) e iniciativas de mídia paga. A função também envolve a gestão de contas oficiais da marca e o desenvolvimento de parcerias com outras indústrias, ampliando a presença e o alcance da marca.

Essa é uma posição hands-on, ideal para alguém que combine visão estratégica com forte capacidade de execução, e que tenha experiência com marketing de performance e iniciativas de crescimento em um ambiente digital dinâmico.

Necessário inglês avançado ou fluente para interação com o time global.

Contrato Presencial em Recife/PE.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Desenvolver e executar estratégias gerais de aquisição de novos usuários, incluindo planos por canal, estratégias de marca, parcerias com KOLs/influenciadores, planejamento de orçamento e acompanhamento de performance.
  • Compreender o perfil dos influenciadores e das principais audiências nas redes sociais no mercado brasileiro, impulsionando colaborações com KOLs alinhadas à marca BingoPlus, gerando tráfego e visibilidade por meio de conteúdo.
  • Possuir conhecimento sólido em marketing de afiliados no mercado brasileiro, sendo responsável pela criação, gestão e relacionamento com parceiros afiliados.
  • Atuar em iniciativas de mídia paga, colaborando com o time global de tráfego da Digiplus para implementar estratégias localizadas de aquisição de usuários e contribuir com recomendações estratégicas.
  • Contribuir com ideias e estratégias para a gestão das redes sociais oficiais, criando conteúdos atrativos e estruturando um modelo consistente de operação dos canais.
  • Planejar e executar colaborações com outras indústrias de forma criativa e proativa, ampliando o alcance e posicionamento da marca.
  • Executar a estratégia de marketing alinhada aos objetivos de crescimento da empresa.
  • Gerenciar e otimizar campanhas de marketing em canais online e offline.
  • Acompanhar e analisar o desempenho das campanhas, garantindo eficiência e melhoria contínua de ROI.
  • Apoiar na gestão do orçamento de marketing, sugerindo alocações eficientes entre canais.
  • Monitorar tendências de mercado, comportamento do usuário e ações da concorrência.
  • Colaborar com Produto, Operações e Compliance para garantir campanhas alinhadas às diretrizes do negócio e requisitos regulatórios.
  • Elaborar relatórios periódicos com análises e recomendações de melhoria.

PROCURAMOS ALGUÉM QUE TENHA

  • Entre 4 e 6 anos de experiência em marketing digital, iGaming ou entretenimento online.
  • Experiência em marketing digital com foco em aquisição de usuários (growth/performance) ;
  • Vivência com mídia paga, afiliados, influenciadores/KOLs e redes sociais ;

description:

title: Latam Marketing Manager
description:
BSI’s Assurance division is hiring a LATAM Marketing Manager to own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy across Latin America with a primary focus on Mexico.

In this role, you will translate global strategy into high-impact, localized programs that fuel pipeline and revenue across System Certification, Training, and ISA, while leading our regional Center of Excellence (CoE) for campaign development, design, and digital execution.

You’ll also serve regionally as a Theme Lead for Quality & Mobility, setting the bar for messaging and integrated campaigns used across the Americas.

If you thrive in a matrixed, fast-paced environment and can flex from strategy to hands-on execution, this role is for you!

What you’ll own:

  • LatAm GTM leadership: Build and deliver the marketing plan for Latin America (with Mexico emphasis) aligned to commercial targets and sector priorities.
  • Localization that wins: Adapt global/regional campaigns to local language, culture, regulation, and buyer behavior.
  • Partner with the business: Collaborate effectively with Sales and Training to shape marketing strategies that move pipeline and revenue.

How you’ll lead:

  • Operational excellence: Drive clarity, workload management, and accountability using project tools (e.g., Workfront); uphold brand, compliance, and governance standards.

How you’ll execute:

  • Full-funnel, integrated campaigns: Orchestrate email, web, SEO/SEM, paid media, social, events/webinars, and ABM to create demand and accelerate conversions.
  • Digital & demand-gen mastery: Increase engagement, improve targeting, and optimize journeys; manage lead workflows in Salesforce and Pardot (segmentation, routing, nurture).
  • Budget ownership: Plan, allocate, and track the LATAM marketing budget for maximum ROI.
  • Vendor leadership: Manage local partners (design, translation, event logistics, media buying) to deliver on brief, on brand, on budget.
  • Brand & governance: Ensure every asset meets BSI’s standards and regional regulatory requirements.

How you’ll measure success:

  • Performance & analytics: Track KPIs and attribution, maintain CRM hygiene, and partner with data teams on ROI reporting.
  • Optimize in real time: Use funnel insights to test, learn, and iterate maximizing conversion and marketing-influenced revenue.

Regional Theme Leadership (Quality & Mobility):

  • Set the bar regionally: Define positioning, content strategy, and integrated campaigns for Quality & Mobility.
  • Scale best practices: Align global messaging with LATAM needs; enable knowledge-sharing and consistent activation across countries.

What you bring:

  • Strategic clarity & executional rigor: You turn business goals into actionable programs that deliver measurable impact.
  • Proven demand gen: History of campaigns that drive MQLs, pipeline, and conversion in complex B2B environments.
  • LATAM expertise: Deep understanding of Mexico and broader LATAM buyer behavior, channels, and regulatory nuances.
  • Localization mastery: You have experience in tailoring global content/messages for maximum regional relevance.
  • Relationship builder: Confident collaborator across Sales, Training, and global teams.
  • Operational savvy: Budget management, vendor oversight, and performance reporting are second nature.
  • Martech fluency: Hands-on with Salesforce and Pardot (required); familiarity with Marketo, Workfront, SEO/SEM, paid media, and ABM tactics.
  • Organized & adaptable: Comfortable switching from big-picture strategy to precise execution; continuous-improvement mindset.
  • Segment & persona chops: You tailor narratives and offers by industry, role, and stage to move deals forward.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field (Master’s preferred).
  • 6+ years progressive B2B marketing experience (professional services, SaaS, or regulated industries ideal), including 3+ years leading people.
  • Proven experience executing marketing across Mexico and broader LATAM.
  • Success running multi-channel GTM in a complex organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and develop marketing professionals and foster cross-functional collaboration.
  • Strong digital demand gen/ABM background and CRM-led workflows (Salesforce/Pardot required).
  • Familiarity with ISO, assurance, training, or compliance services (preferred).
  • Knowledge of Quality or Mobility sectors (preferred).

Language Requirements

A strong command of English, Spanish, and Portuguese is essential - both verbal and written. Please submit your application in English.

BSI - Your Partner in Progress

We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organizations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.

Headquartered in London, United Kingdom, BSI is the world's first national standards organization with more than 100 years of experience. We are a global partner for 86,000 companies and organizations in over 193 countries, offering development, auditing, certification, and training services, including innovative software solutions and cyber security expertise for all industries: from aerospace and automotive to food, construction, energy, healthcare, IT and trade sectors. Incorporated by Royal Charter, we’re truly impartial, and home to the ultimate mark of trust, the Kitemark.

Through our unique combination of consulting, training, assurance and regulatory services we bring solid and broad knowledge to every company.

If you want to contribute to this inspiring challenge, bring your open and enthusiastic mindset to our dynamic team then please apply now!

What we offer

BSI offers a competitive salary, 20-days annual leave, bank holidays, vacation bonus, medical insurance, life insurance, savings fund with company contribution, meal allowance, paid maternity leave, paid paternity leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.

D&I Policy

BSI is committed to ensuring the diversity of our workforce reflects that of our clients and the communities in which we operate. Our goal is to create a sense of belonging for all employees by providing opportunities to develop, grow, and engage with our global organization — all while having fun doing great work. BSI is a community where everyone can thrive.

If you require any reasonable accommodations to be made on account of a disability or impairment throughout our recruiting process, please inform your Talent Acquisition Partner.

title: Especialista de Segurança da Informação

O Arquiteto de Domínio – Computação do Usuário Final tem a responsabilidade de projetar, governar e evoluir as arquiteturas que suportam a experiência do usuário final nas operações da Brasil e Canadá. Isso inclui dispositivos, desktops, laptops, dispositivos móveis, virtualização, colaboração, suporte remoto e soluções de espaço de trabalho digital. O objetivo é oferecer ambientes modernos, seguros e eficientes, alinhados às necessidades dos usuários, garantindo alta disponibilidade, facilidade de uso e integração com plataformas corporativas.

Esse profissional trabalhará colaborativamente para implementar soluções inovadoras que promovam produtividade, segurança, automação e mobilidade, respeitando a governança internacional e os padrões de segurança, e com uma visão clara de transformação digital centrada no usuário.

  • Definir e manter arquiteturas de ponta a ponta para ambientes de Computação do Usuário Final (EUC), abrangendo dispositivos físicos, virtuais, móveis, desktops virtuais (VDI), BYOD e de colaboração.
  • Estabelecer padrões e estruturas para provisionamento, gerenciamento e segurança de dispositivos, incluindo políticas de acesso, controle de identidade (IAM), criptografia e proteção contra ameaças.
  • Liderar iniciativas de modernização e transformação digital para espaços de trabalho inteligentes, com foco em automação, autoatendimento, integração com nuvem, colaboração (MS Teams, Zoom) e aplicações móveis.
  • Avaliar e implementar virtualização, gerenciamento de dispositivos móveis (MDM), segurança de endpoints (EDR), zero-trust, monitoramento e tecnologias de suporte remoto.
  • Trabalhe proativamente para resolver desafios de desempenho, escalabilidade e disponibilidade, garantindo suporte para trabalho remoto e híbrido.

  • Produzir documentação completa, guias, planos de contingência, treinamentos e melhores práticas para equipes de apoio e operações.
  • Participe de fóruns, workshops e projetos de inovação para manter o ambiente tecnológico alinhado com as tendências globais.

Requisitos e Competências

Requisitos Essenciais (Habilidades Técnicas)

  • Ensino superior em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas similares.
  • Sólida experiência (mínimo 8 anos) em arquitetura, gestão e inovação do ambiente de Computação para Usuários Finais, em empresas globais ou setores altamente complexos.
  • Conhecimento avançado em plataformas e ferramentas EUC: Microsoft 365, Windows Desktop, macOS, VDI (Citrix, VMware Horizon), MDM (Intune, MobileIron), ferramentas de colaboração (Teams, Zoom).
  • Expertise em segurança de dispositivos, zero trust, gerenciamento de identidade e acesso (Azure AD, Okta), criptografia, proteção de endpoints, automação e monitoramento.
  • Experiência com ambientes de trabalho híbridos e remotos, suporte técnico avançado e estratégias para maximizar produtividade e segurança.
  • Inglês fluente para comunicação técnica global, português avançado para alinhamento Brasil-Canadá.

Habilidades Interpessoais

  • Capacidade de se comunicar de forma clara e eficaz com equipes técnicas, usuários finais e executivos.

Join us and be part of this new era of interactive cinema!

What Will Your Next Role Look Like?

As Marketing Manager, Brazil , you will lead the development and execution of Peliplat’s local marketing strategy , driving user growth, engagement, and brand positioning in the Brazilian market.

This is a hands-on strategic role : you will not only execute campaigns but also define how Peliplat wins in Brazil —from influencer strategy and community growth to viral campaigns and cultural positioning.

You will work closely with global teams (Product, Content, BD) while acting as the local market expert , ensuring our product and messaging resonate deeply with Brazilian audiences.

Responsibilities

Market Strategy & Growth Ownership

  • Define and execute Peliplat’s go-to-market strategy for Brazil , aligned with company growth targets (downloads, DAU, retention, subscriptions), with emphasis on Mobile Application Development.
  • Localize global strategies to fit the Brazilian audience behaviour, trends, and cultural nuances
  • Identify growth opportunities through viral loops, partnerships, and community-driven mechanics
  • Act as the key voice of the Brazilian market internally

User Acquisition & Campaign Execution

  • Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns , focusing on organic and viral growth channels
  • Develop referral programs, co-watching campaigns, and “watch with friends” mechanics
  • Collaborate with paid media teams (when applicable) to optimize performance campaigns
  • Continuously test and iterate growth strategies based on performance data

Influencer & Creator Strategy

  • Build and manage relationships with Brazilian influencers, film critics, and content creators
  • Identify and onboard creators to host Virtual Screening Rooms and co-watching events
  • Develop scalable influencer programs (from top-tier KOLs to micro-creators)
  • Leverage the “100% revenue to creators” model to attract and retain talent

Community & Event Marketing

  • Drive adoption of Virtual Screening Rooms as core user behaviour
  • Plan and execute high-impact events (e.g., “Watch with (Influencer)”, themed screenings, premieres)
  • Foster a strong community culture through interactive campaigns and social engagement
  • Collaborate with operations teams to ensure successful event execution

Content & Social Media Strategy

  • Define content direction for Brazil across TikTok, Instagram, and other relevant platforms
  • Identify viral content formats (reaction videos, co-watching clips, film discussions)
  • Collaborate with content and ops teams to turn in-app moments into shareable external content
  • Ensure consistent brand voice and cultural relevance

Data-Driven Optimization

  • Track and analyze key metrics: installs, activation, retention, DAU/MAU, engagement
  • Use insights to refine campaigns, content, and user journeys
  • Identify behavioral patterns and optimize funnel performance
  • Report on market performance and recommend strategic adjustments

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product to provide feedback on user experience and localization needs
  • Collaborate with BD and Content teams on creator partnerships and programming
  • Align with global marketing while advocating for Brazil-specific strategies
  • Support long-term brand building and market expansion plans

Qualifications

  • 5–8+ years of experience in marketing, growth, or community roles , ideally in tech, media, or entertainment
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian digital landscape , including social media and influencer ecosystems
  • Proven experience driving user growth, engagement, or community-building initiatives
  • Experience working with influencers, creators, or content-driven platforms
  • Analytical mindset with experience using data to drive decisions
  • Fluent in Portuguese (native level) and strong English proficiency

Who you are

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with strong ownership mentality
  • Deep understanding of internet culture and trends in Brazil
  • Creative thinker with strong execution ability
  • Comfortable balancing strategy and hands-on work
  • Adaptable, fast-moving, and results-driven

Extra Points if you...

  • Passion for film, entertainment, or online communities
  • Experience with short-form video content (TikTok, Reels, etc.)
  • Background in startups or fast-scaling products
  • Familiarity with subscription-based or community-driven platforms

Our Culture

As Peliplat evolves into a global, product-driven company, our culture is not just something we believe in; it’s how we execute.

We are building more than a platform; we are shaping the home of movie buffs and redefining cinema as a shared, interactive experience . This requires a team that thinks beyond traditional models, moves with urgency, and creates value through both creativity and strategy.

Our culture is rooted in people who don’t just operate within systems, but who build, challenge, and scale them .

  • Ownership — Think Like a Builder
  • Strategic Hustle — Create Value Beyond Budget
  • Problem-Solving — Decode Complexity
  • Result Oriented — Drive Real Impact
  • Market Intelligence — Know the Game
  • Passion for Cinema & Community — Build What You Believe In

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência com Cloud Nativa: Hands-on em AWS (Security Hub, GuardDuty, IAM, WAF, Secrets Manager), GCP ou Azure (Defender for Cloud), com foco em políticas de zero-trust e detecção de ameaças.
  • Domínio em OWASP Top 10, CIS Benchmarks, pipelines seguros e conformidade LGPD/PCI-DSS/GDPR.

title: Ecommerce Growth Marketing Senior Paid Media Specialist
description:
We are a DTC Growth Marketing Company focused on helping service businesses grow profitably.

Our Values:

- Treat others the way we want to be treated.

- Pay close attention to detail.

- Don't neglect the small things, they matter.

- Think critically and be a problem solver, not a problem creator.

- Have the confidence and determination to achieve our shared vision.

Who We Are Looking For:

We are looking for an ecommerce Paid Media Specialist who has experience managing large ad budgets across Meta and Google primarily. (Ideally over 1 million dollars USD per month). Additionally, if you experience using MTAs such as NorthBeam, incrementality testing tools, and MMM tools for data validation that is a major plus.

The candidate selected for this role would come in and manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts for US based ecommerce brands. We have a lot of high-profile ecommerce clients that we work with and we are looking for a seasoned Paid Media Specialist who can produce high quality results for our clients.

The right candidate will be task-oriented, analytical, and willing to keep the team and ad accounts on pace to make sure we are meeting or exceeding client expectations. A self-starter who can see problems and go to work fixing them and not be just an order taker. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing Facebook Ads and Google Ads for US based ecommerce brands.

Must have a portfolio of work that demonstrates the results that you have been able to provide and the KPIs you have hit. Must also demonstrate your skills with creative testing through media buying on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok ads.

Responsibilities

  • Manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts of US based ecommerce brands
  • Run ad campaigns across Meta, Google, and TikTok
  • Monitor ROAS, ad budgets, revenue, and core KPIs to optimize campaigns and achieve the desired results for our clients
  • Run profitable creative testing campaigns and identify trends to be able to communicate with the client what is working and what we should be creating more of
  • Create performance marketing reports for the accounts that you are managing to accurately display the analytics, results, and next steps
  • Strategize on ways to improve the overall marketing strategy for our brands to increase effectiveness
  • Maintain awareness of current industry and technology standards, social media, competitive landscape, and market trends

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing or related field OR 3-4 years of experience OR alternative education experience (mentors or courses)
  • Prior experience working for an ecommerce brand or advertising agency is preferred
  • Must be proficient in Facebook & Google Ads management for ecommerce brands
  • Must be proficient in scaling ad budgets
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, and a hunger to always provide great results for our clients
  • Autonomous worker with an analytical mind
  • Portfolio of work, results, or case studies
  • You should be comfortable using some internal communication tools such as Monday.com, Google Drive, Zoom, and Slack for team meetings and to support other team members with any technical request. Experience with Monday.com or Asana is not required but please let us know if you have used it before or not.
  • You should also be confident enough to push back on the leadership team and express your opinion if you think the ship is heading off course. We encourage that.

Compensation:

  • $2000 - $8000 USD per month

Just as a disclaimer, please don't use AI or ChatGPT during the screening or interview process. We use a screening tool that can detect AI in your answers and during interviews. Using AI will result in your application being immediately disqualified.

title: SAP MM Consultant
description:

title: AI Pre-sales Solution Manager (Brazil)
description:

- POC Ownership and Delivery - Define POC scope, success criteria, and technical requirements; design solution architecture and workflow logic; coordinate with TSA, Agent Ops, and Delivery teams; oversee POC execution and present outcome with technical recommendation to the customer.

- Expansion and Continuous Advisory - Identify additional use cases post-implementation; provide solution optimisation recommendations based on operational insights; support renewal and expansion proposals with updated architecture and technical positioning.

- Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or related fields

Minimum 8 years of experience in enterprise pre-sales, solutions consulting, or technical consulting roles

- Proven hands-on experience with voicebots, chatbots, and generative AI technologies including large language models, NLP, STT, and TTS

- Demonstrated ability to build working demos and prototypes independently using AI-assisted development tools

title: Security BISO/PMO
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!

Buscamos: Security BISO/PMO

Resumo:

O Security BISO/PMO atua como um elo estratégico entre as unidades de tecnologia, negócio e a organização de cibersegurança. Essa função garante que as iniciativas de segurança estejam alinhadas aos objetivos do negócio, enquanto gerencia a entrega de projetos de segurança em toda a empresa. O profissional será responsável por conduzir a governança, priorizar demandas de segurança e supervisionar planos e execução de projetos para reduzir riscos e impulsionar o crescimento do negócio.

Responsabilidades:

Alinhamento com o Negócio:

  • Servir como ponto de contato principal para as unidades de negócio em relação às necessidades e iniciativas de cibersegurança.
  • Traduzir requisitos de negócio em estratégias e soluções de segurança acionáveis junto às demais equipes de cibersegurança.
  • Defender a segurança nos processos de negócio, garantindo conformidade com padrões regulatórios e organizacionais.

Gestão de Programas e Projetos:

  • Liderar e gerenciar o portfólio de projetos de segurança, garantindo entrega dentro do escopo, prazo e orçamento.
  • Desenvolver e manter planos de projeto, registros de riscos e relatórios de status para as partes interessadas.
  • Coordenar equipes multifuncionais, incluindo TI, segurança e stakeholders de negócio, para atingir os objetivos dos projetos.

Governança e Relatórios:

  • Estabelecer e manter estruturas de governança para programas de segurança.
  • Acompanhar e reportar indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) e métricas relacionadas às iniciativas de segurança.
  • Garantir alinhamento com requisitos de gestão de riscos corporativos e conformidade.

Gestão de Riscos:

  • Identificar, avaliar e priorizar riscos de segurança que impactam as operações do negócio e alinhar com o registro de riscos do GRC.
  • Colaborar com líderes de negócio para implementar estratégias de mitigação de riscos.

Engajamento com Stakeholders:

  • Comunicar-se de forma eficaz com executivos, líderes de negócio e equipes técnicas.
  • Fornecer atualizações regulares sobre postura de segurança, progresso dos projetos e ameaças emergentes.

Requisitos técnicos e experiência:

  • Graduação em Segurança da Informação, Ciência da Computação, Administração de Empresas ou área relacionada.
  • Mais de 7 anos em funções de cibersegurança, gestão de riscos ou gestão de projetos de segurança.
  • Forte conhecimento de frameworks de cibersegurança (NIST, ISO 27001, etc.).
  • Alta proficiência e experiência prática com metodologias de gestão de projetos, planejamento e entrega, como PMBOK e Agile.
  • Excelente comunicação e capacidade de influenciar e interagir com stakeholders seniores.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de gestão de projetos ou produtos.
  • Conhecimento avançado das ferramentas do Office.
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e de elaboração de relatórios para suporte à entrega de KPIs.
  • Fluência em inglês.

Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Certificações de segurança como CISSP, CompTIA Security+, CySA+, ISO 27001, ITILv3+ ou similares.
  • Certificações em gestão de projetos ou gestão de produtos.
  • Espanhol será um diferencial.

O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:

title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Consultant
description:
Genesis Consulting has an immediate opportunity for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) Consultant to support a large-scale public sector S/4HANA transformation program for a metropolitan transit agency. The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition.

The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support.

The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics.

title: SAO PAULO - [HYBRID] - L2 SOC Analyst
description:
About the Company:

As the founding entity of RAINBOW PARTNERS, Quanteam is a consulting firm specializing in Banking, Finance, and Financial Services. Guided by our core values of closeness, teamwork, diversity, and excellence, our team of 1,000 expert consultants, representing 35 different nationalities, collaborates across 10 international offices: Paris, Lyon, New York, Montreal, London, Brussels, Geneva, Lisbon, Porto, and Casablanca.

We are currently seeking a seasoned Security Analyst (L2) to support one of our clients, a leading international financial institution headquartered in Montreal.

Role Overview:

As a Senior SOC Analyst embedded within a 24x7 Security Operations Center, you will be at the forefront of identifying, analyzing, and neutralizing sophisticated cyber threats targeting critical business infrastructure. Beyond routine alert handling, this role focuses on in-depth forensic investigation, proactive threat hunting, and the continuous strengthening of the SOC’s detection and response capabilities. The analyst in this position serves as a technical anchor for the team, guiding junior colleagues and actively contributing to the organization’s overall security posture.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Threat Detection & Incident Response

  • Ownership: Take the lead on high-severity and complex security events, including intrusions involving persistent adversaries, multi-stage attack chains, and advanced malicious payloads.
  • Investigation: Conduct thorough technical analysis across SIEM platforms, endpoint telemetry, and network traffic data to reconstruct attack timelines and uncover root causes.
  • Escalation Support: Serve as the primary escalation point for junior analysts, offering technical validation, investigative direction, and remediation guidance.
  • Documentation: Ensure all incidents, findings, and response actions are precisely recorded in case management systems to support operational continuity and post-event reviews.

2. Detection Engineering & Threat Hunting

  • Content Development: Design, tune, and maintain detection logic, correlation rules, and monitoring dashboards within SIEM platforms to maximize coverage and reduce alert noise.
  • Proactive Hunting: Initiate hypothesis-driven threat hunt campaigns using intelligence feeds, behavioral baselines, and knowledge of adversary tactics drawn from recognized attack frameworks.
  • Automation: Develop and maintain scripts and tooling (Python, Bash) to accelerate investigative workflows, automate data enrichment, and streamline repetitive SOC tasks.

3. Cross-functional Collaboration & SOC Development

  • Teamwork: Partner with adjacent teams (infrastructure, cloud, identity management, incident response) during active security events and broader remediation efforts.
  • Lessons Learned: Actively contribute to post-incident retrospectives, generating actionable recommendations to strengthen security controls and refine processes.
  • Continuous Improvement: Support tooling upgrades, SOC maturity initiatives, and security projects to keep operational capabilities in step with an evolving threat landscape.

Required Qualifications and Skills:

  • A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in a SOC environment or a comparable senior cybersecurity role.
  • Demonstrated expertise with SIEM platforms (e.g., Splunk, ELK), including the authoring of queries, correlation rules, and custom dashboards.
  • Advanced understanding of security technologies spanning network defense (firewalls, IDS/IPS, proxies, VPN), endpoint protection (EDR/XDR), and data security solutions.
  • Solid grounding in incident response lifecycle, log analysis techniques, and packet capture (PCAP) examination.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of core networking protocols and architectures (OSI model, TCP/IP, DNS, SMTP).
  • Thorough understanding of attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures, with practical familiarity with frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Hands-on experience in both Windows and Linux environments, including the ability to identify indicators of compromise and abnormal system behavior.
  • Proficiency in scripting (Python, Bash) applied to investigation support and process automation.
  • A proactive, adversarial mindset with a continuous drive toward improved threat detection and defense.

Working conditions:

  • Candidate must be located or willing to relocate to Brazil (São Paulo)
  • Hybrid schedule with 3 days on-site per week
  • Participation in on-call rotations and extended coverage hours required
  • Availability for morning or daytime shifts, including weekend assignments as part of 24/7 operations
  • Fluency in English required

title: Lead Test Engineer
description:
Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Europe - Romania, Poland, and Ukraine, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.

Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past three years and plans to continue growing.

Key responsibilities

  • Demonstrate a deep, system-level understanding of the entire product architecture to ensure comprehensive and thorough testing across all layers.
  • Proactively identify, coordinate, and manage cross-team dependencies to ensure seamless end-to-end quality and delivery.
  • Employ extensive testing experience across Native Mobile Applications, Backend services, and Front-end systems .
  • Design and execute advanced testing techniques, including thorough Monkey Testing , and champion the introduction of Chaos Engineering practices into the development pipeline.
  • Identify tasks/dependencies/risks during backlog grooming/planning.
  • Provide reasonable test estimates and feedback on priorities.
  • Fully understand and actively provide ways to improve project/solution level test strategy/test design principles.
  • Contribute to the evaluation of testing tools/techniques/strategies.
  • Contribute effectively to the development of a project's test strategy and automation suite.
  • Collaborate with developers/business analysts for feedback into software design and tests.
  • Assist with effective test reporting and contribute to ensuring the CI/CD pipeline has thorough test coverages.
  • Contribute effectively to utilize an automation framework for testing and the creation of test scripts (different automation test layers such as UI or API Acceptance Tests).
  • Identify gaps in the current automation suite and help prioritize those / get them into the backlog.
  • Investigate and assist in diagnosing issues.
  • Share testing/product knowledge with other team members.

Must have

  • 5+ years of professional experience in Quality Assurance or Software Testing, with a focus on large, complex, and distributed systems.
  • Proven experience as a coordinator or leader managing QA activities across multiple, interdependent teams and technical domains (Mobile, Web, Backend).
  • Deep expertise in various testing methodologies, including mandatory experience with Monkey Testing and/or a strong theoretical or practical background in Chaos Engineering/Resilience Testing.
  • Mandatory professional experience testing: Native Mobile Applications (iOS and/or Android), Distributed Backend/Microservices Platforms.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms, preferably AWS, and understanding of how cloud services (e.g., EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS) impact system testing.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Professional experience in complex frontend web applications.
  • Automation is a plus; experience programming or scripting in at least one modern language (e.g., Python or Ruby).

What we offer

  • 100% remote in Poland, Romania, Ukraine, or Brazil.
  • B2B Contract.
  • English classes.

title: Senior QA Analyst - Live Games
description:
We're looking for a talented and detail-obsessed Senior Quality Assurance Analyst to join Wildlife's Quality Assurance team, focused on our Live Games portfolio.

As a Senior QA Analyst, you will be responsible for estimating, planning, and executing test cases across our live titles — evaluating risks and impact, defining quality strategy, and helping the team grow through knowledge sharing. You will communicate testing demands and quality metrics to both developers and other analysts, owning the bridge between QA and engineering.

This role starts with broad coverage across all Wildlife live games, with the longer-term path of migrating into a single high-impact title as ownership deepens. Professional posture, sharp communication, and influence skills are essential - even though this is not a people-management role, you will interact across multiple disciplines and seniority levels.

The right person for this position is curious by nature, comfortable in a "take the initiative" environment, loves solving problems, and thrives in a fast-paced live operations context where every build matters.

What You'll Do

  • Execute manual testing with a meticulous eye across Wildlife's live games portfolio, ensuring every build meets our quality bar before reaching millions of daily players.
  • Own the end-to-end bug flow: identify, reproduce, write clear bug reports, prioritize based on impact, and decide whether issues go to backlog or require immediate fix.
  • Write, refine, and continuously optimize test cases - leveraging AI tools (Cursor, LLMs) to accelerate case creation and improve description quality at scale.
  • Apply AI-assisted build analysis: compare build A vs build B by analyzing code diffs (via Cursor), identifying changed files, and using structured prompts to surface high-risk areas before testing begins.
  • Hunt corner cases - go beyond the happy path to find edge scenarios that no one else catches, before players do.
  • Deploy builds on physical devices (iOS and Android), validating real-world behavior, performance, and UX.
  • Monitor and analyze post-release quality using Firebase, Crashlytics, and internal QA tooling (QA Hub).
  • Define and evolve quality metrics that engineering and product use to make decisions - not just report them.
  • Collaborate directly with engineering on debugging, prioritization, and release decisions.
  • Provide your team with a quality strategy that supports delivery goals and aligns with Wildlife's overall quality strategy.
  • Advocate for user experience and game quality across product, design, and engineering conversations.
  • Participate as one of the first analysts on new game projects when needed - helping new dev teams establish quality processes and standards from the ground up.

What You'll Need

  • University degree in computing-related fields (Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Systems Analysis and Development) - or equivalent practical experience.
  • Previous professional experience in software development or game testing, with at least 2 consecutive years in mobile games or high-cadence live operations environments.
  • Strong understanding of computer science fundamentals: data structures, networking, concurrency, memory management, and algorithm analysis.
  • Solid command of software testing concepts: testability, escape rate, regression, unit, integration, soak, stress, and test automation.
  • Demonstrated experience with Firebase, Crashlytics, or equivalent crash analytics and monitoring tooling in production environments.
  • Track record of writing, structuring, and optimizing test cases with method - not just executing scripts written by others.
  • Proven ability to identify non-obvious corner cases, with concrete examples of critical bugs you found that others missed.
  • Hands-on experience deploying and validating builds on physical iOS and Android devices.
  • Active use of AI in your QA workflow - Cursor, ChatGPT, Copilot, or equivalent tools applied to code analysis, test case generation, or debugging.
  • Clear technical communication - you can speak the developer's language without losing the quality lens.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with live games at scale (millions of DAU).
  • Track record of creating quality metrics that were adopted by engineering teams.
  • Familiarity with Unity, C#, or mobile-native stacks.
  • Experience with mobile test automation (Appium, XCTest, Espresso) - even though this role is primarily manual.
  • Understanding of DevOps tools such as Chef, Ansible, Jenkins, or similar.

More About You

  • You're passionate about games and about software development - and you know how to ensure its quality.
  • You thrive in agile environments and stimulate that mindset in your team.
  • You're creative when solving problems and continuously seek improvements in processes and solutions.
  • You communicate clearly with your team and the broader company to identify issues and align demands.
  • You have the autonomy to recognize current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes on the final result.
  • You are professionally postured and exercise influence even outside of formal leadership roles - knowing how to interact with multiple disciplines and higher job levels with credibility.

How We Work

This role is hybrid, with 3 days per week in our Itaim Bibi office (São Paulo). The in-person time is a deliberate accelerator for pair debugging, faster decisions with engineering, and high-bandwidth alignment. The remaining 2 days are remote.

About Wildlife

Wildlife is one of the leading mobile game developers and publishers in the world. We have released more than 60 titles, reaching billions of people around the globe. Today, we have offices in Brazil, Argentina, Ireland, and the United States. Here, we create games that will excite, intrigue, and engage our players for years to come.

Equal Opportunity

Wildlife is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, colour, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law.

We're committed to providing accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process.

  • Experiência com grandes empresas (área comercial e/ou gerenciamento de projetos internos) conseguindo se conectar com diferentes públicos e ter fortes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração;
